name: [🚗 DRIVE-THRU] Burger Game 🍔
desc:
🍔 Welcome to Burger Game, the ultimate cooking and kitchen chaos simulator!
🎉 More updates coming soon!

[ How to Play ]
• Customers arrive during the daytime!
• Accept customer orders from the order board!
• Use the ingredient bar and meat grillers to build each burger!
• Serve customers their burgers to earn money!
• Don’t go bankrupt!

👨‍🍳 Step into the role of a busy chef! Cook burgers, serve customers, and manage your own fast-food restaurant.
🔥 Work the kitchen, build perfect burgers, and survive the diner rush for max profits!
👥 Play solo or team up with friends to run the best cooking operation in town.

🐦 Follow us on X for secret codes and updates!
💬 Join our community server to meet other players and give feedback to the developers!
💎 Roblox Premium? Get +25% bonus earnings every shift!

🚧 Still in early development! More features are on the way, so stay tuned!

scripts.title: auto buy
scripts.features:
Will buy if the amount of something, for example, bread is less than 5.

PLS KEEP THIS A SECRET FROM THE DEVELOPERS, ADMINS AND MODERATORS OF THIS GAME!!! - ПОЖАЛУЙСТА ХРАНИТЕ ЭТО В СЕКРЕТЕ ОТ РАЗРАБОТЧИКОВ, АДМИНОВ И МОДЕРАТОРОВ ЭТОЙ ИГРЫ!!!
scripts.script:
local objs = workspace.GameData.Objects
local tell = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Tell")

while wait(1) do
    if objs.Boxbrgr.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.Boxbac.Amount.Value < 5 then
        tell:FireServer("Order", "Meat")

    elseif objs.Boxltc.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.Boxoni.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.Boxpcl.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.Boxtom.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.Boxchz.Amount.Value < 5 then
        tell:FireServer("Order", "Veggies")

    elseif objs.Boxbbun.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.Boxtbun.Amount.Value < 5 then
        tell:FireServer("Order", "Bread")

    elseif objs.Boxfri.Amount.Value < 5 then
        tell:FireServer("Order", "Fries")

    elseif objs.Boxreal.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.BoxFriCon.Amount.Value < 5 then
        tell:FireServer("Order", "Cups")
        
    elseif objs.BoxBag.Amount.Value < 5 or objs.Boxtray.Amount.Value < 5 then
        tell:FireServer("Order", "Trays")
    end
end
